WITH apr_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999
),
apr_oct_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
),
april_sales AS (
    SELECT s.ss_customer_sk, s.ss_item_sk, s.ss_ticket_number, s.ss_net_profit, s.ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales s
    JOIN apr_dates d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = s.ss_sold_date_sk
),
sales_returns AS (
    SELECT r.sr_customer_sk, r.sr_item_sk, r.sr_net_loss, s.ss_item_sk, s.ss_store_sk, s.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_returns r
    JOIN apr_oct_dates d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = r.sr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN april_sales s
      ON s.ss_customer_sk = r.sr_customer_sk
     AND s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk
     AND s.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
),
catalog_matches AS (
    SELECT r.ss_item_sk, r.ss_store_sk, r.ss_net_profit, r.sr_net_loss, c.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales c
    JOIN apr_oct_dates d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = c.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN sales_returns r
      ON r.sr_customer_sk = c.cs_bill_customer_sk
     AND r.sr_item_sk = c.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name,
       max(m.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       max(m.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       max(m.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM catalog_matches m
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = m.ss_item_sk
JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = m.ss_store_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
